subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Is the July 2 internal-path Mantis manifest plus scheduler regression matrix sufficient proof for this generated-media wake-false fix, or should this PR remain blocked until a visible/live gateway-channel proof artifact exists?
rationale: The code path is internal and hard to trigger through normal Telegram Desktop, but the repository's PR proof gate normally requires observed after-fix behavior for external PRs.

options.title: Require Live Proof
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until the proof stack or an equivalent hook shows baseline missing or blocking the media and candidate delivering exactly one generated media item.

options.title: Accept Internal Proof
options.body: Treat the July 2 Mantis manifest and scheduler tests as sufficient for this internal failure mode and clear the proof blocker by maintainer intent.

options.title: Pause The Direction
options.body: Leave the PR draft blocked if maintainers do not want to merge a production fallback that cannot be demonstrated through the current live proof harness.
